templates.label: Set a piece on their team
templates.subject: Choreographer for {studio}'s competition team
templates.body:
Hi {studio} team!

My name is Tori Ugalde. I'm a choreographer and teacher in Orlando, and I would love to set a piece on your dancers this season.

I teach at Dance With Dixon ProSeries and Celebration Arts Academy, and I've set competition work from solos to large groups. My musical theatre duet Stepsisters Lament won the Judges Award, "Broadway Bound," at StarQuest Nationals in 2025. I also design and build costumes, so the look can come with the piece.

Videos of my work and my resume are all here:
{site}

Solos, duets, groups, musical theatre, jazz, contemporary: I'd love to hear what your team needs.

Thank you so much!

{signature}

templates.subject: Teaching, subbing or a master class at {studio}
templates.body:
Hi {studio} team!

My name is Tori Ugalde. I teach dance in Orlando, and I'm looking to add teaching this season: a weekly class, subbing, or a master class.

Right now I lead Technique & Flexibility for ages 5 to 9 at DWD ProSeries, and I teach jazz, musical theatre, acro and contemporary, from littles through elite competition dancers and adult beginners.

My work, my resume and videos are here:
{site}

If you ever need a sub, I'm one text away. I would love to come meet your dancers!

Thank you!

{signature}
